This page is about the location. For the building at this location, see Fort of Permafrost (Building).

Other languages:
  • English

A large bridge, as cold as the earth surrounding it. The fort ahead whistles softly, holding strong its icy armour and powerful aura as a testament to those who built it.

Fort of Permafrost is a location that can be found in the Jarvonia region.
